decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Prior approval is required and it is recommended that it is refused for the following reason:

The proposed mast and associated equipment would not been sited, so far as is practicable, to minimise its impact upon the appearance of the area. By reason of its size, position and appearance, it would result in an unsightly over proliferation of street furniture and be unduly obtrusive, detrimental to the visual amenity of the Great West Road and would harm the living conditions of adjoining residential property by reason of loss of outlook. It would also result in the loss of an existing cycle rack. It would be contrary to policies ENV B.1.1 (All New Development) and B.1.7 (Telecommunications) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Installation of a 13.5m telecommunications mast with 3 antennas, a dish and two equipment cabins
